caption.text: Go has no exceptions — and that is the whole design, not a missing feature. This handbook walks the full error model end to end: errors as ordinary values, sentinels and custom types, `%w` wrapping and the `Unwrap` contract, `errors.Is` vs `errors.As`, then the separate world of panic, defer and recover. Ten pages of the traps that actually bite in production — typed-nil interfaces, shadowed `err`, swallowed `Close` errors, and recover that never fires.
